components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action in a local task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #1264ff); border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent, #1264ff); font: 700 14px/1 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #0758ec); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(18,100,255,.3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A familiar bordered action that stays below the primary command.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-bright, #c8d8f2); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text, #101828); background: #fff; font: 650 13px/1 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #a9c3ed; background: var(--accent-soft, #edf4ff); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(18,100,255,.3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: A wide, quiet resource search field for the current organization.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search authorized resources"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; width: 360px; height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-bright, #c8d8f2); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--muted, #5d6b82); background: #fff; } .ds-search svg { width: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--text, #101828); background: transparent; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #1264ff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(18,100,255,.09); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #7a879c; } .ds-search input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }

components.name: Language Switcher
components.description: The synchronized Chinese and English product-version selector used on sign-in and authenticated surfaces.
components.html: <fieldset class="ds-language"><legend class="sr-only">Language</legend><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">中文</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">EN</button></fieldset>
components.css: .ds-language { display: inline-flex; height: 34px; margin: 0; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line-bright, #c8d8f2); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--panel-raised, #f3f7ff); } .ds-language button { min-width: 38px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--muted, #5d6b82); background: transparent; font: 700 12px/1 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-language button[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--accent, #1264ff); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(39,92,180,.14); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: One workspace destination with an underline that carries current selection.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-tab is-active" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7"/></svg>Overview</button>
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; height: 57px; padding: 0; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; color: #41516b; background: #fff; font: 700 13px/1 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-tab svg { width: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: var(--accent, #1264ff); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(18,100,255,.3); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-nav-tab.is-active { color: var(--accent, #1264ff); } .ds-nav-tab.is-active::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: currentColor; content: ''; }

Current operations

narrative.overview:
A3S Cloud is a bright enterprise AI product portal and operations workspace. A pure white canvas, cool blue hairlines, compact typography, and one electric-blue field explain product value and expose current state without turning the product into a generic infrastructure dashboard.

The public homepage leads with Workflow, Agent Factory, and the security operations center. It then reveals the shared A3S foundation, all 17 roadmap gates, and the authority that owns each outcome.
keyCharacteristics: White and pale-blue operating surfaces with one dominant electric-blue field.
Workflow, Agent Factory, and security operations form the outward-facing product layer.
All 17 product gates remain visible with authoritative delivery states.
Compact, factual hierarchy designed for repeated use by platform operators.
Explicit control and execution ownership, ending at the sole A3S Code Harness.
Near-flat surfaces, cool hairlines, and sparse blue-tinted elevation.
Structural responsive reflow with preserved labels and touch targets.
Simplified Chinese by default with a complete, persistent English product version.

rules.name: The One Blue Field Rule
rules.body: Give each viewport one dominant blue field; use all other blue as action, selection, or wayfinding.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red must communicate real state and never decorate neutral content.

rules.name: The Scan First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with size and weight; do not add visible eyebrow labels above headings.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace belongs to code, commands, identifiers, and measured output, not to product personality.

rules.name: The Authority Beside Action Rule
rules.body: When width permits, place current operational truth next to the A3S component that owns the next transition.

rules.name: The Product Before Proof Rule
rules.body: Explain the three customer outcomes before exposing implementation gates and architecture evidence.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use a cool boundary for structural surfaces and reserve visible shadow for shells or overlays that genuinely sit above them.

rules.name: The Language Parity Rule
rules.body: A visible feature is complete only when its Chinese and English copy, state labels, dates, and accessible names describe the same behavior.

dos: Do show the selected organization, project, and environment before operational detail.
Do pair state with text or an icon instead of relying on color alone.
Do keep standard controls familiar, keyboard reachable, and at least 40px to 44px on touch layouts.
Do use real API projections and label planned architecture modules explicitly.
Do lead the public story with Workflow, Agent Factory, and security operations before gate evidence.
Do keep homepage, architecture, and documentation on one shared 17-gate catalog.
Do preserve the A3S authority path and the sole A3S Code Harness boundary.
Do keep default Chinese and selectable English at feature parity, including dynamic states and accessible names.
donts: Don't create a second Harness, execution owner, or parallel orchestration story.
Don't scatter full-saturation blue across inactive surfaces.
Don't use visible eyebrow labels, gradient text, decorative glass, or technical monospace as costume.
Don't invent customer names, scale metrics, availability claims, or completed roadmap capabilities.
Don't replace gate evidence with a subjective completion percentage.
Don't describe the three products as separate controllers, runtimes, or node channels.
Don't compress desktop layouts onto mobile; reflow modules and allow purposeful horizontal scrolling for tab or tenant rails.
Don't infer the default language from the browser or create per-page language state.
